alt: Table of Sloczynski's decomposition for the unweighted and survey-weighted cell regressions: 14% of workers work from home, yet the contrast for home workers receives 83% of the regression's weight.
note: Cell-fixed-effect model. p(X) is the linear projection of WFH on the cells and the age–sex terms; ATT and ATU are Sloczynski's average partial linear effects, equal to the causal ATT and ATU only under unconfoundedness and linearity in p(X). Coefficient = ω₁·ATT + (1 − ω₁)·ATU exactly.
source: IPUMS USA, ACS 2024 1-year (SAMPLE 202401), analysis/usa/acs/part_2020_2024.parquet; replicate weights REPWTP1–80 from analysis/usa/acs_repwt/part_2020_2024.parquet
title: Smaller groups get larger weights
